subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

Mahendra told her that he would be waiting for her at the theatre.

options.text: Mahendra told her, “He will be waiting for her at the theatre.”
Mahendra asked her, “I will be waiting for you at the theatre.”
Mahendra inquired her, “He will be waiting for you at the theatre.”
Mahendra told her, “I will be waiting for you at the theatre.”

solution:
The correct answer is: **Mahendra told her, "I will be waiting for you at the theatre."**
